What this agent does: Per-client X Agent (client-facing name; same engine architecture as the LinkedIn Agent). Run once per client: it reverse-engineers the client's X AUDIENCE (who is listening, which accounts already win their attention, where the conversations happen), builds a VOICE PROFILE per managed account (founder or brand handle: earned claims, sampled diction, what this account can credibly say), derives 2-3 ORGANIC X post formats from the menu (single posts, threads, reply/quote engagement), and then EMITS per-client generator sub-skills (one per format) that draft on a schedule with full context of everything posted before via a shared ledger. Mirrors the Instagram engine (karos-instagram-agent) and LinkedIn engine (karos-linkedin-agent) architecture: run-once master, parallel research, per-client sub-skills at status:draft, shared ledger continuity. Use when onboarding an X client, "set up x/twitter for {client}", "build the x engine for {company}", "spawn x posts for {client}". Triggers: /x-agent, /x-agent {client}.

Follow the client's brand voice and profile docs. Prefer the client's emitted sub-skills when they exist. Deliver production-ready output — no placeholders, no unfinished drafts.
